headline: Anthropic IPO likely to price above $70 to $78 range, CNBC reports
body: Multiple sources told CNBC that Anthropic is likely to price its IPO above the current range of $70 to $78. The company is planning to close the order books at 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, according to the people. For the nine months ended Sept. 30, Anthropic said it generated $33.24 billion in revenue, according to its prospectus.
note: The report rests on people who were not authorized to speak publicly, so the final pricing is the number to watch.

evidence.text: Anthropic is likely to price its IPO above the current range of $70 to $78, multiple sources told CNBC's David Faber on Tuesday.
The company is planning to close the order books and lock in total demand at 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, according to the people.

The artificial intelligence company is planning to close the order books and lock in total demand at 4 p.m. ET on Tuesday, according to the people, who asked not to be named because they were not authorized to speak publicly.
Anthropic is slated to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" and start trading on Nov. 19.
For the nine months ended Sept. 30, Anthropic said it generated $33.24 billion in revenue, up roughly 1,200% from the same period last year, according to its prospectus .
